witnesses.name: proof_of_cm_expr_type_code_context_entail_wit_1
witnesses.strategy: Choose the whole VC's right disjunct. Rewrite cm_expr_rep with cm_expr_rep_node and unfold cm_expr_node. Extract expr_pre <> 0 and the existing a, b, args pointers. Instantiate the consequent existentials in its pargs, pb, pa order with args, b, a; retain all seven field cells and the opaque cm_expr_payload unchanged, and cancel. No arithmetic or new helper is needed.

split_strategies.proof_of_cm_expr_type_code_context_retur: Rewrite the RHS cm_expr_rep using cm_expr_rep_node and unfold cm_expr_node. Supply the existing pa, pb, pargs as a, b, args witnesses and discharge the node's nonnull fact with PreH9. Cancel the seven unchanged expression field cells and cm_expr_payload. The supplied scalar bounds need no additional derivation; do not unfold the recursive payload.

witnesses.name: proof_of_cm_expr_lvalue_count_context_entail_wit_1
witnesses.strategy: Choose one whole-VC disjunct (the two are identical). Unfold cm_program_context_rep and cm_function_context_rep on the antecedent; extract their nonnull facts and s, g, t, params, locals pointer witnesses. Supply the consequent zl, zp, zt, zg, zs with locals, params, t, g, s. Reintroduce the five existing PreH facts without unfolding them; rearrange and cancel all program/function fields, list predicates and the unchanged cm_expr_rep frame.

witnesses.name: proof_of_cm_expr_rvalue_count_context_entail_wit_1
witnesses.strategy: Choose one whole-VC disjunct. Unfold the two context predicates, extract program_pre <> 0, fn_pre <> 0 and their five pointer witnesses; instantiate RHS zl, zp, zt, zg, zs with locals, params, strings, globals, structs respectively. Preserve PreH1 through PreH5 and cancel the reordered program/function fields and list predicates while framing cm_expr_rep expr_pre e. No count-model reasoning is required.

witnesses.name: proof_of_cm_stmt_code_count_context_entail_wit_1
witnesses.strategy: Choose one whole-VC disjunct. Unfold cm_program_context_rep and cm_function_context_rep, extract their nonnull facts and five pointer witnesses, and instantiate RHS zl, zp, zt, zg, zs with the same locals, params, strings, globals, structs pointers. Carry PreH1 through PreH5, including loop_-indexed statement well-formedness, unchanged. Cancel the program/function fields and list resources, keeping cm_stmt_rep stmt_pre s opaque as the frame.

split_strategies.proof_of_cm_expr_lvalue_count_context_re: Unfold the two RHS context predicates. Use PreH12 and PreH13 for program/function nonnull facts; instantiate program structs/globals/strings with zs/zg/zt and function params/locals with zp/zl. Reassociate and commute the existing field/list resources into these two contexts, preserving functions_ptr, body, next and all model projections. Cancel cm_expr_rep expr_pre e as an unchanged frame. Only the spatial split is the target; no result arithmetic or new helper is needed.

split_strategies.proof_of_cm_expr_rvalue_count_context_re: Unfold RHS cm_program_context_rep and cm_function_context_rep. Reconstruct them using the current zs, zg, zt and zp, zl witnesses plus PreH12/PreH13 nonnull hypotheses. Cancel every program/function field and its corresponding list predicate after spatial reordering; frame cm_expr_rep expr_pre e. The rvalue result facts remain assumptions and require no model unfolding in this spatial split.

split_strategies.proof_of_cm_stmt_code_count_context_retu: Unfold both RHS context predicates, supply zs/zg/zt and zp/zl as their existential pointers, and prove nonnull from PreH12/PreH13. Reorder the ret_ty cell returned alongside the statement into the function context with params, locals, body and next; combine the program fields and three list predicates into the program context. Cancel the opaque cm_stmt_rep stmt_pre s frame. Scalar bounds and count equalities already present do not require further work for this split.
